retrievalProfile.description: A minimalist white layout featuring a small centered square photograph flanked by symmetrical columns of script text and anchored by a diagonal serif footer.
triggerTerms: centered square photo with columns of text

recipe.visualDefinition: A clean, spacious composition on a stark white field. A small, high-contrast square photograph is positioned in the center. Above it, large calligraphic display text is paired with a widely spaced serif subtitle. Flanking the photo are two columns of elegant script. The bottom right is anchored by a bold, all-caps serif line set at a 20-degree upward angle.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetry between left and right text columns around a central anchor
Contrast between fluid calligraphic headers and rigid geometric serif subtitles
Extreme negative space emphasizing the central photographic subject
Dynamic tension created by the diagonal footer against the horizontal header
coreInvariants: Wide letter-spacing for secondary serif text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Small square photograph centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 15% of the total area.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large calligraphic header at the top center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down from header to subtitle, then scanning the two side columns, finishing at the diagonal bottom-right text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white space surrounding all elements, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Pure white background for clarity and minimalism.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black for primary typography and photo shadows.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Dark burgundy or sepia for the diagonal footer text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High contrast between the dark elements and the white field; low saturation overall.
paletteRestrictions: Limited to black, white, and one dark accent tone

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: High-contrast calligraphic script and classical Roman serifs.
letterConstructionRules: Display script features extreme thick-to-thin transitions and elongated swashes on capitals.
Subtitles use wide tracking (letter-spacing) to fill horizontal space.
Footer text uses a slab-like serif with uniform stroke weight for a stamped effect.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Capital M and G in display text feature circular flourishes.
Lowercase script letters are disconnected and upright.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Triadic contrast: fluid script for names, wide-tracked serif for metadata, and heavy diagonal serif for emphasis.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the high-contrast flourished script style of the header.
Matches the wide-tracked, small-cap serif feel of the subtitles.
Provides the sturdy, slab-serif structure for the diagonal footer.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a stark white canvas with a small, high-contrast square photograph centered. The photo should feature a warm-toned, low-key lit subject against a dark background.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply calligraphic display text at the top, followed by a wide-tracked serif subtitle. Place two columns of delicate script on either side of the photo. Add a bold, all-caps serif line at a 20-degree angle in the bottom right corner.

verificationChecks: Is the central image a perfect square?
Is the footer text angled upwards at approximately 20 degrees?
Is there significant white space between all elements?
Are the side columns of text vertically aligned with the central photo?

postGenerationChecks: Check for even distribution of negative space.
Ensure the script text is legible but delicate.
Verify the diagonal text does not touch the edges of the canvas.
Confirm the color of the diagonal text is distinct from the black header.
recipe.reuseFormula: Centralized square anchor + Symmetrical script columns + Wide-tracked serif header + Diagonal footer accent.
